mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_document (title, source, source_ref, chunk_count, file_size, content, original_content, fetch_status, translation_status, storage_status, vector_status, pipeline_error) VALUES (#{title}, #{source}, #{sourceRef}, #{chunkCount}, #{fileSize}, #{content}, #{originalContent}, COALESCE(#{fetchStatus}, 'DONE'), COALESCE(#{translationStatus}, 'DONE'), COALESCE(#{storageStatus}, 'DONE'), COALESCE(#{vectorStatus}, 'DONE'), #{pipelineError})
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, source, source_ref, chunk_count, file_size, create_time FROM knowledge_document ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT id, title, source, source_ref, chunk_count, file_size, content, original_content, fetch_status, translation_status, storage_status, vector_status, pipeline_error, create_time FROM knowledge_document ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_document SET title = #{title}, chunk_count = #{chunkCount}, content = #{content}, original_content = COALESCE(#{originalContent}, original_content), fetch_status = #{fetchStatus}, translation_status = #{translationStatus}, storage_status = #{storageStatus}, vector_status = #{vectorStatus}, pipeline_error = #{pipelineError} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, source, source_ref, chunk_count, file_size, content, original_content, fetch_status, translation_status, storage_status, vector_status, pipeline_error, create_time FROM knowledge_document WHERE source = 'GITHUB' AND (translation_status != 'DONE' OR storage_status != 'DONE' OR vector_status != 'DONE') ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
